result.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
result.summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SpatialASM：用带 allocentric 新视角生成器的训练期空间模拟，把「主动空间心理化」内化为 LVLM 能力，生成显式 ASM 轨迹与视角转换任务两类监督，并在七个空间推理基准与四个骨干上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 VLM 空间推理中的视角规划与心理场景模拟，其轨迹监督、视角条件想象任务可供核查 LVR 关注的 LOOK 式取景决策、视觉证据筛选与内部空间表征保留等问题，属于训练期监督而非推理期 latent 生成。
